scope: Node VM regression tests plus automated real-browser E2E (playwright, headless Chromium).
fixedInThisVersion: Step 3 of the OpenRouter spec: text-to-speech through OpenRouter (default google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts, picker limited to speech models, voices per seat from the model's supported_voices) and Groq (Orpheus, English or Arabic only; other languages read by the browser voice, stated in the plan note).

OpenRouter speech is requested as pcm (Gemini TTS is recorded by an external implementation to return PCM only); the reply is told apart by its first bytes and content-type (WAV, MP3, Ogg, FLAC kept; anything else wrapped as 16-bit mono WAV at the content-type rate or 24 kHz). Speed goes to the API for OpenAI models and to pitch-preserving playback otherwise; failures, 429 and a missing key fall back to the browser voice. Streaming playback is left until the format is confirmed on a real account.
reviewNotReproduced: Carried over from v1.4.13: the external review reported double counting of a single response. Still not reproduced.
regressionProof: test-hub-tts (new, 6) and test-model-picker-ui 8->11: format detection and WAV header values, seat voices, API speed vs playback rate, fallbacks, Groq language limit and default voices, try; in headless Chromium: OpenRouter and Groq offered, voices built from the model list, 0.3 s of raw PCM plays as 24 kHz WAV for 0.3 s, Groq panel and its English-only note.
realBrowserE2E: tests/test-browser.cjs, tests/test-settings-ui.cjs and tests/test-model-picker-ui.cjs pass, 24 checks.
notVerified: Real OpenRouter and Groq speech: format, sample rate, CORS; Groq Orpheus input limits.
Everything listed as unverified in 1.4.45 still stands.
